chunks: He who does not listen to the summoner of God cannot weaken (the power of) God on earth, nor will he have protectors other than Him. They are clearly in the wrong.
ai.seo_question: Who is the 'summoner of God' and what happens to those who do not answer him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Caller of God' (Da'i Allah) is often interpreted as the Prophet Muhammad or the Imams, whose authority is intrinsic to divine guidance. This verse underscores that rejection of their call results in a lack of any intercessor or protector other than God Himself, highlighting the inevitability of divine retribution. The mention of 'not being able to escape on earth' refers to the tangible consequences of their disbelief in this world, while 'clear misguidance' signifies their spiritual deviation.
